messages:
samir: FYI customer 'Acme Corp' says AWS Marketplace invoice for May is 1,203,456 tokens but our usage dashboard shows 952,318. Can someone triage?

billing-bot: Automated alert: marketplace invoice imported (invoice_id: INV-2026-05-ACME). Imported at 2026-05-31T02:14:07Z.

maya: Ack. Can you paste the invoice line item id and the marketplace sku? Need the exact mapping.

samir: invoice line: 98765, sku: redwood.inference.us-west-2.metered_tokens.v1, customer marketplace_acct: 111-ACME. Repro steps I tried: pulled our raw metering events (per-second) and aggregated to daily, got ~952k.

lee: Do we apply any marketplace multiplier or proration at ingestion? I remember AWS sometimes reports prorated per-second usage differently for marketplace listings.

samir: Not on our side — ingestion just ingests raw event token_count. But the marketplace manifest might apply a per-second multiplier. I checked our ingestion logs: ``fetcher: processed 2026-05-01..2026-05-31 events, total_tokens=952318``

maya: Can you export a sample of raw events for May 15-16 and the invoice CSV for the same range? Also include line_item_timestamp and quantity columns.

samir: Uploaded sample to GCS: gs://redwood-support/acme/may15-16-raw-events.ndjson and gs://redwood-support/acme/invoice-inv-98765.csv (shared with @rachel-support).

rachel-support: I pulled the invoice CSV. Line 42 shows quantity=250000 for 2026-05-15T12:00:00Z. Marketplace has a "usage_window_seconds" field set to 1 in the invoice JSON blob — suspicious.

lee: That suggests AWS reported per-second increments but then also applied a scaling factor when generating the invoice. We should diff raw events vs marketplace meter reports. Samir can you run this quick query on the raw events index:
```
SELECT SUM(token_count) as tokens, COUNT(*) as events
FROM marketplace_raw_events
WHERE customer_id='111-ACME' AND ts >= '2026-05-15' AND ts < '2026-05-16'
```
and paste results?

samir: Query output: tokens=125,003, events=86400 (one per second). So looks like they reported one event per second with small token counts. If ACS (AWS) multiplied per-second windows by some aggregation factor during billing that could explain gap.

maya: Two hypotheses: 1) AWS applied an internal multiplier (metering dimension mapping) we don't mirror; 2) our aggregator deduped/rounded events for per-second granularity and dropped fractional tokens. Need to check rounding behavior in the ingestion pipeline.

eng-billing: Adding context from billing side: invoice quantities come from marketplace usage reports which sometimes expand usage windows. Also see issue where meter_tag alias caused double-counting for certain skus in 2025-11 that we fixed. Not the same but useful to compare.

lee: Samir, can you produce a small repro where you replay raw events into the local aggregator (no dedupe/no rounding) and see aggregated total? Use the replay tool: ``./tools/replay_raw_events --customer 111-ACME --start 2026-05-15 --end 2026-05-16 --no-dedupe``

samir: Running now. Replay results: total_tokens_strict=250,003 when no-dedupe and preserving fractional counts. With standard pipeline (dedupe + floor rounding) we get 125,001. So it looks like the invoice matches the no-dedupe count (250k) while our dashboard matches deduped/floored count (~125k) — there's a consistent ~2x factor for that day.

maya: Interesting. That 2x could be coming from a marketplace reporting window being 2s or a multiplier of 2 in the SKU configuration. I'll open a support case with AWS marketplace for the sku mapping and share the marketplace usage report.

rachel-support: Customer is escalating — they've paused usage until this resolves. Can we propose temporary credit for the discrepancy window while we investigate?

eng-billing: Agree we should offer provisional credit. Propose crediting difference for May 15-16 and continue investigation. I'll prepare a credit memo draft.

lee: Action items: 1) @maya open AWS marketplace case with invoice and raw usage sample (in progress). 2) @samir run a full-month strict replay and attach results (ETA 2 hours). 3) @eng-billing prepare provisional credit and hold final until AWS confirms. 4) @rachel-support coordinate customer comms.

samir: Full-month strict replay done: strict_total=1,203,780 tokens, pipeline_total=952,318 tokens. Delta=251,462 tokens (~26% higher). Uploading csv to gs://redwood-support/acme/may-full-replay.csv

maya: Case opened with AWS (case# AWS-MP-7629). AWS acknowledged they saw a "reporting_window_seconds" attribute in the usage report for this SKU set to 2 in some partitions for May due to a legacy marketplace mapping. They are investigating whether it should have been 1.

rachel-support: Customer update: told them we found likely cause, offered provisional credit for delta for May, they accepted. Keeping them in the loop until AWS confirms.

eng-billing: I'll draft the credit memo and internal incident notes. After AWS confirms, we can reconcile and post final credit.

maya: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene on thread after AWS reply. :thumbsup:
